Fund Accounting Professional with 13+ years of experience at Northern Trust.Specializing in Pricing, Fund Accounting, Project Management and NewBusiness Transition. Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives,analyzing complex financial data, and driving process improvements to enhanceoperational efficiency and organizational performance. Seeking to leverage myeducation, professional expertise, and core competencies to contribute toorganizational growth while advancing my career development.2021 - 2025NORTHERN TRUSTConsultant - Officer2017 - 2021Technical Co-Ordinator
Implemented Benchmarking Project for EMEA region from India,achieving a 50% reduction in EMS exceptionsActively contributed to BAC Tool implementation for Benchmarking,enhancing efficiency and accuracyCompleted Invest‑One GIO Upgradation Project 20.1 testing, ensuringsmooth transition and system reliabilityCollaborated with IT, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver businessanalysis and strategy projects on time and with high qualitySuccessfully managed multiple transitions across UK, Lux, Ireland, andSaudi Regions, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer and processcontinuityDeveloped and executed strategies to transition work from BenchmarkingTeam to New Business Transition Team, improving workflow alignmentOversaw North America New Business activities from India, ensuringeffective coordination and deliveryPrepared and reviewed NAVs in Fund Accounting, ensuringaccuracy and complianceRegularly updated client procedures to maintain consistency andoperational standardsCoordinated with cross‑functional teams including Pricing, Custody,Transfer Agency, Budget, and Financial Reporting enhancingworkflow efficiencyImplemented POP and iTool projects, streamlining processes andimproving efficiencyServed as Subject Matter Expert providing guidance and expertiseMentored junior team members and developed training plans tostrengthen team capabilities
2012 - DEC 2025
Built and maintained strong relationships with partners, managers,and vendors to support key business initiatives
Ensured consistency and efficiency across daily process flowsthrough proactive monitoring
Conducted pricing reviews, including provider, stale, and tolerancechecks, improving data accuracy
Reviewed and cleaned Bloomberg pricing data, reducing snap issuesand enhancing reliability
Performed vendor quality checks, identified alternatives for unpricedassets, and resolved exceptions for out‑of‑tolerance securitiesFinancial Analyst2012 - 2015
Contributed to implementing a Paperless Project for the Pricing Team,delivering measurable cost savings and operational efficiency
Participated in pilot testing of PDQ Reports, NAV Macro, and eRMtool for CF MPU Projects, resulting in significant time savings
Identified process gaps and proposed solutions, leading toimprovement in workflow accuracy
Resolved audit queries and client inquiries, maintaining 100%compliance and strengthening client trust
Leveraged extensive knowledge of market data vendors Bloomberg,ICE, Refinitiv to optimize data quality and vendor management
Managed escalations and adhoc requests, effectively handlinghigh‑volume periods while meeting deadlinesFinancial Senior Analyst2015 - 2017
